# ADO003: unknown-property

A property is not allowed by the Azure Pipelines schema.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Syntax and schema |
| **Default severity** | error |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | schema validation of the template-expanded pipeline |

## Description

The key is not part of the official schema for this element, often because of a typo. A suggestion is shown when a close match exists.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
jobs:
- job: Build
  dependOn: Setup
```

Instead:

```yaml
jobs:
- job: Build
  dependsOn: Setup
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO003: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO003` or `--enable ADO003`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO003
```

Questions about ADO003, or a false positive? [Open an issue](https://github.com/danielsada/go-ado-pipelines-lint/issues/new?title=ADO003%3A+) with the YAML that triggered it.
